headlines.title: Trump says he’ll roll back Biden-era methane rules for oil and gas companies
headlines.description: The EPA plans to ease regulations aimed at curbing methane leaks, Trump said. The potent greenhouse gas is a major contributor to climate change.

headlines.title: Fed expected to hold interest rates steady as inflation tops midterm voters’ concerns
headlines.description: Officials believe there is plenty of time left to tackle inflation, allowing them to avoid making a move so close to an election.

headlines.title: Data center group jumps into the Kansas governor’s race to boost Republicans
headlines.description: Building the Future is an offshoot of the pro-AI super PAC Leading the Future, arguably the leading super PAC promoting industry interests in the midterm elections.

headlines.title: Anthropic reveals $80 billion loss, huge spending spree ahead of IPO
headlines.description: Artificial intelligence startup Anthropic unveils its first public IPO filing ahead of what is expected to be one of the largest stock debuts in history.

headlines.title: Advocate for Elizabeth Holmes' innocence threatens to sue A24, Nathan Fielder over doc
headlines.description: New bombshell A24 documentary “You Can See Everything” draws backlash from a supporter of Elizabeth Holmes’ technology after clips of him were in the film, he says, without his permission. Now, he’s threatening to sue the filmmakers if they don't apologize. NBC News’ Chloe Melas reports.

headlines.title: Screens crack on Apple’s new foldable iPhone
headlines.description: The iPhone Duo went on sale less than a week ago, but some users are already reporting cracks and bright lines across the inner display near the hinge. NBC News’ Brian Cheung reports.

headlines.title: Microsoft Offers Voluntary Buyouts to More Than 25% of Workforce
headlines.description: Microsoft announced Monday it is offering voluntary buyouts to about 60,000 employees, more than a quarter of its global workforce. It is unclear how many positions the tech giant hopes to eliminate.

headlines.title: AI startup Anthropic unveils its public IPO filing for the first time
headlines.description: Artificial intelligence startup Anthropic unveiled its public IPO filing for the first time ahead of what is expected to be one of the largest stock debuts in history. NBC News' Allie Canal reports on the details surrounding Anthropic ahead of its IPO.

headlines.title: Shop Life-Changing Finds Under $50 to Solve Everyday Problems
headlines.description: From a key finder to flashlight gloves, Shop TODAY fashion and lifestyle contributor Chassie Post walks through some life-changing finds starting under $50.

headlines.title: Crowds around the world turn out for the launch of Apple’s new foldable iPhone Duo
headlines.description: The foldable iPhone Duo is finally here, and like so many highly anticipated Apple releases in the past, people waited hours to be among the first to get their hands on it. NBC News’ Brian Cheung reports.

headlines.title: 'Looksmaxxing' influencer Clavicular pleads not guilty in alleged rape case
headlines.description: Braden Peters, better known as the controversial influencer “Clavicular,” was in court today to enter a plea after he was accused of raping an intoxicated 17-year-old last April. NBC News’ George Solis reports.

headlines.title: Goldman Sachs spends big to give small businesses an AI boost
headlines.description: The Wall Street giant is committing $500 million to expand its 10,000 Small Businesses program and launch an AI institute, partnering with Google, Meta, OpenAI and Anthropic to bring AI know-how to Main Street. NBC's Christine Romans spoke exclusively with Goldman Sachs CEO David Solomon and with small businesses figuring out how to make AI work for them.
